scope: Read-only source and live Studio investigation; no runtime migration, source edit, gate verdict or publication

baseline.authorization: Owner requested investigation of Structure requirements after approving the proposed port presentation. No new Stage9 implementation gate is inferred. Later local continuation records qualify the historical handoff baseline; no remote/main or production changes are made.

conclusion.summary: Structure uses the public FlowCanvas and shared layout/navigation today, but reusable Structure rendering, exploration and semantic projection remain substantially Studio-owned. The current authored rich-node workspace is not a drop-in replacement. This is a reuse/parity gap, not evidence that Structure's existing behavior is broken.
conclusion.meaningOf100Percent: VICT-owned reusable components and authoritative document/command semantics, with thin Studio data/navigation/label adapters. Product composition and thin adapters can remain; moving every host-specific menu or label into core is not the goal. VICT continues to use its pinned upstream rendering engine.

requirements.requirement: Canvas rendering, camera, minimap, measured layout, orientation and async-layout fencing
requirements.sharedCoverage: Available at the low-level public API
requirements.currentUse: StructureView consumes FlowCanvas, FlowNavigation, Controls, layoutGraph and LayoutFence from @victframework/ui-flow-svelte
requirements.remaining: Extract/adopt Structure exploration policy separately; do not claim GraphViewport is used today.

requirements.requirement: Cards with source identity, warnings, collapse controls and independent input/output columns
requirements.sharedCoverage: Generic authored bodies and SourceIdentity exist; exact Structure card is Studio-only
requirements.currentUse: StructuredSourceNode.svelte owns the card, counts and two-column rows
requirements.remaining: Reusable slotted card/port-list composition and disclosure/count presentation. Structure already implements the approved side-by-side layout.

requirements.requirement: Read-only relationship sockets alongside separately authorized move handles
requirements.sharedCoverage: Low-level Handle supports this; GraphPortRow has a body-wide connectability policy
requirements.currentUse: Declared relationship handles are nonconnectable; content/container handles are enabled only for Move inside
requirements.remaining: Explicit reusable per-port interaction policy or separate reference-port primitive. Do not make declared dependency edges freely rewritable to fit a generic graph editor.

requirements.requirement: Grouped/coincident relations, member counts, partial selection, port/edge hover and keyboard tracing
requirements.sharedCoverage: Low-level events available; reusable grouped-reference controller/renderer absent from current public exports
requirements.remaining: Shared group identity and member-preserving selection/highlight parts, preserving every declaration ID/path and origin.

requirements.requirement: External controlled selection synchronized with Layers, Design and Inspector
requirements.sharedCoverage: ui-editor selectionOperation exists and FlowCanvas accepts controlled nodes/edges; rich workspace uses its own GraphSelection/session
requirements.currentUse: StructureView and Designer adapt WorkspaceSelection and explicit selection intents
requirements.remaining: Reusable projection-view selection/controller seam without creating a second canonical editor history or silently dropping edge/group members.

requirements.requirement: Hierarchy/dependency views, search, focused neighbourhoods, collapse/expand and stable placement
requirements.sharedCoverage: Underlying graph drawing/layout available; exploration and position-retention policy remain Studio-owned
requirements.remaining: Reusable exploration controller with complete results and explicit progressive disclosure; preserve positions and camera independently of document edits.

requirements.requirement: Measured routes, backward links around cards, grouped line painting and tracing
requirements.sharedCoverage: RoutedEdge and layout routes exist; generic appearance routes alone do not implement all Structure behavior
requirements.currentUse: StructureEdge and structure-edge-geometry.ts retain backward-corridor routing, duplicate painting and trace state
requirements.remaining: Extract generic measured routing/trace behavior or supply a documented reusable custom-edge seam. Cosmetic edge-style options do not prove routing parity.

requirements.requirement: Authoritative UiDocument projection and safe source reparenting
requirements.sharedCoverage: Canonical UiDocument, typed visitors and ui-editor moveRelative/EditorBridge transactions provide authority; full source-to-relationship projection is Studio-only
requirements.currentUse: structure-semantics.ts defines 23 relation roles and scoped expression projection; structure.ts validates document/revision/occurrence before moveRelative; Designer applies the transaction draft
requirements.remaining: Expose a shared UI-source projection/Structure composition with descriptor/action/route context as inputs. Keep UiDocument as source of truth; do not replace it with an independently edited flow graph.

policyFindings.finding: chooseLayoutEngine forces Dagre for more than120 nodes even when ELK is explicitly requested
policyFindings.effect: Changes requested routing/layout; does not reject or omit nodes
policyFindings.recommendation: Separate automatic performance preference from explicit engine choice; preserve cancellation/stale-result fences. Existing large-layout tests deliberately assert this policy, so a change needs new evidence rather than relabelling the old result.

policyFindings.finding: Focused view starts at25 items with explicit Show more batches of24; complete counts use Infinity and expansion is available
policyFindings.effect: Presentation paging, not a hard source/evidence quota
policyFindings.recommendation: Keep completeness/count/expansion explicit in a shared explorer; do not equate this with the removed tool-evidence budget.

boundaries: Structure displays authored source relationships, not the live application flow's runtime node instances. The CampaignGraph JSON value is visible as state; the14 runtime campaign nodes are a different graph from the authored UI source tree.
New owned-handle, port-row halo and nested-gesture repairs apply to their shared authored adapters. Structure's raw FlowCanvas/custom node/edge path does not automatically inherit all such policies.
Cosmetic route/style overrides should not replace fixed semantic read/write/containment cues without preserving their meaning.
The approved cleaner labels and independent columns remain an authorized direction; this investigation does not claim they were implemented in the authored app.
recommendedSequence: Freeze a Structure parity matrix covering every existing role, grouped selection, search/disclosure, navigation, route geometry, blocked/stale reparenting and source immutability.

Extract neutral graph-view/card/reference-port/trace/routing parts into the flow presentation package, and UI-source semantics into a shared editor-level projection. Keep dependency direction acyclic; choose an optional composition seam before freezing the package API.
Migrate Structure to those shared components while retaining thin Studio context, menus/navigation and the existing EditorBridge source authority.

Prove the same components in a separate public-package consumer plus real Structure keyboard/touch/desktop journeys, one-history source edits, reopen and negative tests. Preserve existing failures and independently verify before any100-percent parity claim.
